card.name: Descriptive words in general prose
card.fires_on: Fires on a noun, adjective or verb in ordinary web prose, usually just before or inside a noun phrase, such as 'detail', 'delightful', 'hub' or 'moment'. It appears in narrative or promotional text, not in drug-label text.

modes.label: Nouns ending a phrase
modes.description: A noun that completes a descriptive phrase, often after an adjective.
modes.example: Careful attention was given to every<< detail>> of their design to promote a healthy environment

modes.label: Adjectives before a noun
modes.description: An adjective of size, degree or tone that sits right before the noun it describes.
modes.example: The latest weapon unleashed to battle California's<< growing>> energy demand comes in the form of free

modes.label: Verbs and particles
modes.description: A verb or particle in a descriptive clause.
modes.example: Tucked<< away>> behind the Education Center, it’s known
